about.heading: About Us
about.description: Cursor Community Kazakhstan is a local developer community built around Cursor, an AI-powered software development platform valued at $29.3B with millions of users worldwide.
about.ambassador: The community is organized with support from the Cursor Ambassador program — a global network of ambassadors who host meetups, hackathons, and workshops in their cities.

faq.a: Cursor is an AI-powered software development platform based in San Francisco. In 2025, the company raised $2.3B at a $29.3B valuation. Millions of developers worldwide use Cursor.

faq.q: How do I join the community?
faq.a: Join our Telegram channel — we post event announcements, share useful resources, and chat there.
We host Cafe Cursor meetups and workshops in Almaty and Astana. Follow announcements on Telegram and Luma.
